text:
jamie: Pager -> I'm seeing a spike in metering ingestion latency and several customers reporting zero usage in the dashboard. Some invoices are also flagged as delayed in the billing queue. Paging oncall.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED: billing-metering-pipeline (sev-2) — triggered by consumer-lag alert on metering-aggregator. Pager routed to @jamie.

lee: I'm on it, grabbing runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/metering-ingest. Quick guess: consumer groups lagging after an autoscaler event.

devika: Seeing the same in billing job logs — aggregator-consumer lag is at ~120k messages behind for shard-07. Affected tenants mostly on EU region and some dedicated customers. No signs of data loss yet, just delayed processing.

jamie: Thanks. Action plan: 1) reduce consumer rebalancing pressure (set consumers to steady count), 2) kick a backfill job for the last 24h for affected tenants, 3) publish status page + customer note.

lee: Preventative mitigations done: pinned consumer group to 6 replicas, disabled autoscale for metering-consumer in EU for 20m. Monitoring showing lag trend flattening.

devika: I'm prepping a backfill. Command I'll run (dry-run first):

```
# backfill meter events for shard-07 for last 24h
./scripts/metering_backfill --shard=07 --start="2026-03-08T00:00:00Z" --end="2026-03-09T00:00:00Z" --tenants="list_from_alert"
```

sam: Heads-up from CS: we already got 3 tickets about invoice previews showing zero usage. Customer tone is "we're blocked" for a few. We should provide ETA in public comms.

jamie: Draft status page update (please edit):

"We are investigating increased processing latency in our billing metering pipeline which is causing delayed usage visibility for a subset of customers in Europe. Root cause appears related to a consumer rebalancing event. We have applied mitigations to stabilize consumers and started a targeted backfill for affected data. We expect visibility to be restored for most customers within 2-4 hours. Invoices that would normally be generated during this window may be delayed; we will notify affected customers directly and ensure no billing errors occur."

devika: Good. Suggest adding: "No charges will be lost; invoices may be delayed but will reflect actual usage once backfill completes."

jamie: Draft customer-facing email for affected accounts (CS template):

"Hi <Customer Name>,

We're reaching out about an issue affecting usage visibility and invoice previews for some accounts in the Europe region. Our engineering team detected a processing delay in the metering pipeline caused by a consumer rebalance event. We've applied mitigations and started backfilling the missing events. We expect dashboards and invoice previews to return to normal within 2-4 hours. No charges will be missed — if your invoice timing is affected, we'll notify you with a revised ETA and any adjustments.

If you have urgent concerns, reply to this email or open a support ticket and we'll prioritize it.

Thanks,
Redwood Billing & Support"

sam: I'll queue that note to customers who've opened tickets and tag high-impact accounts for manual outreach.

lee: Monitoring update: consumer lag dropped from 120k -> 18k in the last 12 minutes after pinning. Backfill dry-run looks clean; starting live backfill now with rate limit to avoid more pressure. Logs: `backfill: started`, `throttle: 250 rps`.

billing-bot: Automated check: invoices-queue shows 42 items with status DELAYED. No duplicates detected by checksum validation.

devika: Backfill progress: ~12% done for shard-07. Estimated completion 2h based on current throughput. I'll raise priority if lag stops decreasing.

jamie: Quick note for status page: set Incident State -> "Investigating" -> update to "Identified" once backfill confirmed and to "Monitoring" when dashboard visibility returns for >90% impacted accounts.

sam: CS will post an initial message to customers within 30m. I'll attach the draft and mark customers impacted based on tickets and the billing-bot list.

lee: If backfill stalls, plan B is to run an alternate consumer pair in a separate VPC to drain backlog faster. That'll require an infra change and a brief config switch. Leave as contingency.

jamie: Agreed. Add follow-ups: postmortem owner = devika, target RCA within 72 hours. Runbook updates: add a section about consumer autoscaler cooldowns.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ACTIONS CREATED: backfill-job-1769998888, customer-notify-batch-1769998888, postmortem-task-1769998888.

devika: Live backfill completed for shard-07 at 1769999100. Aggregator confirms events reprocessed. Billing queue reconciled: DELAYED -> PROCESSING -> 0 over 3 min.

lee: Dashboard visibility check: sampled 10 affected tenants, 9/10 show usage restored. We're moving incident to Monitoring.

sam: Sent customer notifications to the queued tickets and high-touch accounts. One customer replied asking for invoice hold confirmation; I confirmed we will not auto-charge until reconciliation completes.

jamie: Handoff: I'm oncall until 10:30 UTC; handing to @lee after that. Lee, please monitor for 2 more hours and escalate if regression >5% affected.

lee: Acknowledged. I'll monitor and update the status page to "Resolved" once we sustain <1% regression for 1 hour.

devika: Postmortem owner noted. I'll start collecting logs and a timeline, aim to publish a draft in 48h.

jamie: Thanks team. Closing chat here but keeping the incident thread pinned for follow-up. :thumbsup:
